attributes.name: Valheim
attributes.description: Valheim dedicated server (SteamCMD auto-installed on create). Set a strong password - required by the server. Crossplay not included.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Min 5 chars, must not contain the server name

installation.script:
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1 > /dev/null
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar xzf steamcmd.tar.gz
rm -f steamcmd.tar.gz
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /data +login anonymous +app_update 896660 validate +quit
chmod +x /data/valheim_server.x86_64
